nodes.title: Type-A rowmotion homomesy conjecture

nodes.summary: For a partially ordered set $P$, a function $f$ from the finite antichains of $P$ to $\mathbb{Q}$ is the antichain cardinality statistic when $f(A) = |A|$ for every finite antichain $A$ of $P$.
nodes.title: Antichain cardinality statistic

nodes.summary: For a partially ordered set $P$, a map $\rho$ from the finite antichains of $P$ to themselves is antichain rowmotion when $\rho$ is bijective and, for every finite antichain $A$, $\rho(A)$ is the set of minimal elements of the complement of the down-set of $A$: an element $x \in P$ lies in $\rho(A)$ exactly when $x \not\le a$ for all $a \in A$ and every $y \le x$ with $y \not\le a$ for all $a \in A$ equals $x$.
nodes.title: Rowmotion on antichains

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a type, $\sigma \colon X \to X$ a map, $f \colon X \to \mathbb{Q}$ a function and $c \in \mathbb{Q}$. Then $f$ is homomesic under $\sigma$ with average $c$ when $X$ is finite, $\sigma$ is bijective, and for every $x \in X$ and every $k > 0$ with $\sigma^k(x) = x$ the average $\frac{1}{k} \sum_{i=0}^{k-1} f(\sigma^i(x))$ equals $c$.
nodes.title: Homomesy

nodes.summary: A partially ordered set $P$ is a type-A root poset of rank $n$, for a natural number $n$, when there is a bijection $a \mapsto (i_a, j_a)$ from $P$ onto the set of pairs $(i, j)$ of integers with $0 \le i \le j < n$ such that $a \le b$ holds exactly when the interval $[i_a, j_a]$ is contained in $[i_b, j_b]$, that is, $i_b \le i_a$ and $j_a \le j_b$.
nodes.title: Type-A root poset

nodes.summary: For a partially ordered set $P$, the finite antichains of $P$ are the finite subsets $A \subseteq P$ in which no element is below a different element.
nodes.title: Finite antichains of a poset

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
